name: Pentech Holdings Berhad
overview: Pentech Holdings Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所ACE市场完成首次公开募股（IPO），发行171,995,000股新股。公司业务线未在公告中披露具体变化，最新财报显示2025财年营收与净利润较2024财年有所增长。
overview_en: Pentech Holdings Berhad completed its initial public offering (IPO) on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad in 2026, involving the public issue of 171,995,000 new ordinary shares. No specific changes to business segments were disclosed in the announcements, while the latest financial statements show revenue and net profit increased in FY2025 compared to FY2024.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成IPO并在ACE市场上市，未披露业务板块具体变化。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market in 2026, with no specific segment changes disclosed.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF PENTECH HOLDINGS BERHAD ("PENTECH" OR "COMPANY") ON THE ACE MARKET OF BUR
actions.text: 完成首次公开募股，公开发行171,995,000股新股，并在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市。
actions.text_en: Completed initial public offering with a public issue of 171,995,000 new ordinary shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
